# OpenEye

> Open-source "Ollama for vision" — a CLI-first perception engine that turns raw video into structured world models for robots, VLA models, and autonomous agents.

OpenEye provides open-source perception infrastructure for the next generation of embodied AI. It runs locally on commodity GPUs, ships as a pipx-installable CLI, and exposes a scene-graph API that converts visual input into structured observations for agents and robots.
